description: This file defines the CachedMessageBlock class, a data structure used for storing and managing cached messages in a tightly packed memory block within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes methods for adding, removing, and querying messages, as well as retrieving sequence tokens and searching within the block.

classes.name: CachedMessageBlock
classes.description: A tightly packed memory block that holds cached messages, providing efficient methods to add, remove, and query messages for stream processing.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes the oldest message from the start of the block, advancing the read index.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new cached message to the end of the block, if there is capacity.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Accesses the cached message at the specified index within the block.

methods.name: GetSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token of the message at the specified index.

methods.name: GetNewestSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token of the newest (most recent) message in the block.

methods.name: GetOldestSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the sequence token of the oldest message in the block.

methods.name: GetIndexOfFirstMessageLessThanOrEqualTo
methods.description: Finds the index of the first message with a sequence token less than or equal to the given token.

methods.name: TryFindFirstMessage
methods.description: Attempts to find the first message in the block that belongs to a specific stream.

methods.name: TryFindNextMessage
methods.description: Searches for the next message from a specified stream starting at a given index.
